children.value: > Fact From Story: NBA prop bets are an easy way to jump into basketball betting.
> > Fact From Story: Proposition bets, or props, are easy to understand, numerous, and cover both player props and team props to give you plenty of variety.
> > > Fact From Story: In the NBA, prop bets deal with both players and teams.
> > > Fact From Story: A prop bet is a side wager on an aspect of a game that usually doesn’t tie directly to the result.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People enjoy having options when betting.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Simple and varied activities are often more easily adopted.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Betting on sports is a popular form of entertainment.
